author: claude
title: Pregame screen does not remove future-volume selection
body: The source tape universe needs 50k eventual volume, while downstream screening needs only 25k pregame. Pregame entries also use completed pregame totals.
evidence: CLI default __main__.py:49 is 50000; tapes.py:30 filters total volume; calibration.py:44 uses completed pre_usd.

author: claude
title: Monthly wallet ranking includes later fills and unknown outcomes
body: Full-tape positions are assigned their earliest fill time, then admitted as history by that time.
evidence: Reproduction: Feb 1 selection includes a Feb 2 fill; cost 900.50 instead of 0.50. See PEER_REVIEW_EVIDENCE.json monthly_selection.

author: claude
title: Threshold entries reuse their signal print without executable capacity
body: The first print triggering the rule is also priced as a 100 dollar entry. Later-copy proxies likewise lack reusable liquidity accounting.
evidence: threshold_bets selects first matching fill and shares=STAKE/price; independent delayed whale check finds 83.1% of 248 first-event prints below 100 dollars.

author: claude
title: Inning-ending plays create impossible duplicate states
body: Third-out originals remain in the old half/inning and their outs become zero; correctly advanced checkpoint copies are also emitted.
evidence: Synthetic reproduction emits top fifth zero outs and bottom fifth zero outs at the same third-out timestamp; see state_and_capture evidence.

author: claude
title: State pricing incorporates a future window and subsequent plays
body: The price median from 15 to 75 seconds after a state is treated as a trading reference without moving decision time or bounding by the next play.
evidence: 45,420/137,384 non-checkpoint rows with a next PA have its contact before the window end; H3 entry use at hypotheses.py:190.

author: claude
title: Rejecting dollar weighting conflates different trading policies
body: One bet per market is incorrectly described as the only tradable weighting; causal capped proportional sizing is a different hypothesis.
evidence: Source prose explicitly says only weighting that matters; first-per-event results differ from all-signal combined-band results in review evidence.

author: claude
title: Cache reuse ignores code, inputs and requested split
body: Named pickle files are reused solely based on existence, allowing stale results after new data or parameter changes.
evidence: families.pkl and walkforward.pkl names contain no split, window, code or data identity; cached returns before running fn.

author: claude
title: Persistent index hides new studies
body: Existing index is trusted without checking newly written ledgers.
evidence: GET health reports25 ledgers, GET index reports22; all3 football slugs absent while direct strategy GET returns200.

author: claude
title: Sampled ledgers cannot fulfill every-trade walkthrough
body: Four larger studies export only 20000 rows each; API pagination is over those samples.
evidence: 65,040/34,120/44,295/190,954 source trades become 20,000 rows each; verified index metadata.

author: claude
title: Sport-specific views retain global headline metrics
body: Trade rows filter by sport but development and holdout cards always use meta.headline.
evidence: favorite_at_90 holdout card all-sport -0.856%; football rows -1.145% on65 trades; renderStrategy reads unfiltered headline.

author: claude
title: Documented clean install omits web dependencies
body: FastAPI and Uvicorn are imported but absent from the requirements installed by the quick start.
evidence: server.py:17 imports fastapi; webapp/__main__.py:7 imports uvicorn; neither is declared.

author: claude
title: All-fill claims omit trading earlier than 24 hours before start
body: Collector window begins at game_start minus24h, truncating market and wallet history.
evidence: Read-only API probes for UCL final, Belgium-Senegal and Seahawks-Patriots each returned3 valid fills48-24h before start outside requested collection window.

author: claude
title: UTC rollover capture fails without next-day game metadata
body: Recorder only emits metadata for newly discovered tokens, while book and score sinks rotate daily; analyzer requires per-day metadata.
evidence: Actual live-latency --day2026-09-19 exits1 FileNotFoundError games.jsonl despite approximately2GB clob file and score logs.
